## In plain English
Activation and thin file_scope-widen PRs are gating the first implement spawn correctly, but merging them took 21-42 minutes on 2026-10-18 when a CI round is about 5 minutes. Most of the gap was extra heads and re-runs: lifecycle PR rebase races under strict=true, fix pushes for misses that offline checks would catch, and body-only fixes that re-run the full merge gate. Prefer-A binds the issue A/B/C package: run the narrow existing checks before first push on those PR classes, move body-only checks off the merge gate, and order cohort lifecycle PRs to cut rebases — without touching merge authority, file_scope SoT, Greptile carve-outs, or the worktrees-probe flake (#5735).

## Proposed Bound remedy (draft — critics refute before bind)
relieves: P1
- Before first push on activation and thin file_scope-widen PRs, run the narrow existing checks: deft verify:docs-impact -- --body-file --base-ref (#4293), task pr:check-closing-keywords --body-file, and the CHANGELOG check. This is not the full pre-pr envelope. Leftover-complete / lifecycle-only lands keep the commands.md drive-to envelope exemption (tip line that refuses pre-pr+review-cycle+suite for file-copy lands).
relieves: P1
- Add an offline deft-story check that catches a missing deft-story: N token with no PR number. Today evaluateFullStoryMarkAdmission / Path B activation admit short-circuit or skip hard-fail when prNumber is null (tip packages/core/src/pr-closing-keywords/main.ts).
relieves: P1
- Add an advisory-only check that file_scope covers the files the brief plan names. Warn only; never write file_scope; paths are never taken from issue text (#3835).
relieves: P2
- Move docs-impact into an edited-triggered job the way branch-gate.yml already handles closing-keywords. Keep ci.yml required-check surface unchanged for TypeScript and Greptile.
relieves: P2
- Remove the duplicate closing-keywords run from check:merge (Taskfile.yml verify:closing-keywords dep). Until that lands, review-cycle guidance must name gh run rerun <id> --failed for body-only fixes; forbid empty commits without approval (existing SKILL rule).
relieves: P3
- Through-merge / swarm guidance orders cohort lifecycle PRs: land leftover-complete before opening the next activation PR, and batch activations per cohort. Cite and tighten existing pointers (core-phase-5-6). Mid-story widen racing another story activation stays named residual where order cannot prevent it.
relieves: P4
- CHANGELOG [Unreleased] for #5736.

## Reject
- Changing green-to-merge hand-off or absorbing #5727 / #4889 merge-finisher work
- Widening the #3678 artifact-only allowlist to xbrief/active/**
- Any stand-in for the story own landed file_scope (working-tree brief, locally minted scope, another story merge-base brief)
- A Greptile carve-out (#3680)
- Fixing the worktrees-probe flake here (#5735 owns it)
- Full pre-pr envelope on activation/widen (narrow checks only)
- Making the file_scope-coverage check write or invent paths from issue text
- Changing branch-protection required checks (TypeScript / Greptile) as the latency fix
- Treating leftover-complete lands as newly subject to pre-pr

## file_scope lean (post-bind)
content/skills/deft-directive-swarm/** (lifecycle PR order guidance), content/skills/deft-directive-review-cycle/SKILL.md (gh run rerun --failed for body-only), .github/workflows/branch-gate.yml and/or ci.yml (edited docs-impact job; required checks unchanged), Taskfile.yml (drop duplicate closing-keywords from check:merge), packages/core/src/pr-closing-keywords/** (offline deft-story), verify:docs-impact / pre-push wiring for activation+widen, content/commands.md if exemption/pointer needs clarity, tests, CHANGELOG.md.

## Keep-outs
#5735 flake; #3680 Greptile carve-out; #5727/#4889 merge authority; #3678 allowlist widen; #4956 write-fence SoT; #3835 no paths from issue text.

Round 1 fresh critic. Inputs: Prefer-A draft 6256283254, Stop 1 6256286688, panel-deposit 6256342707 and issue body. No sibling posts. Verification: pin-read git show e463c92d2eac0bbbf7c85f2eb2df0eb4462a914c: against dest cwd-without-occupy. No implementation or ingest.

Verdict: no blocks-the-design; four sharpens-framing findings. A+B+C is a reasonable bounded cut. I did not reproduce the historical timing measurements and do not claim to refute them.

Existing mechanisms re-verified:
- content/commands.md, verify:completed-tracked: file-copy exemption covers completed/cancelled briefs plus optional CHANGELOG, not arbitrary active-brief changes.
- branch-gate.yml: closing-keywords runs on opened/synchronize/reopened/edited with live PR body and commit inputs, mode both.
- ci.yml: docs-impact exists in BOTH primary and failover merge lanes; CI uses default pull_request activity types. Its map identifies TypeScript as the required branch-protection aggregator. Greptile's org-ruleset requirement is envelope evidence, not something this YAML proves.
- Taskfile.yml: check:merge aliases check:framework-source, which owns verify:closing-keywords. tasks/verify.yml documents local merge-base and live-PR modes.
- pr-closing-keywords/main.ts: live-only invocation, Path B null-PR rejection, subsequent null-PR success return, canonical mark parser, per-brief issue binding, leftover admission and skip-active refusal all exist.
- Review-cycle already forbids unapproved Greptile retriggers including empty commits, but does not name gh run rerun <id> --failed. Swarm core-phase-5-6 already assigns post-merge completion/finalization, durable lifecycle landing and merger-owned synchronization.

1. **sharpens-framing — docs-impact is body-sensitive, not body-only.**
Evidence: packages/core/src/docs/docs-impact.ts compares declarations with detected closed-surface changes; live mode obtains body and intended base from REST and evaluates the checkout diff. Existing branch-gate has four activity types, not edited alone.
Failure mode: an edited-only replacement misses freshly opened PRs and code pushes invalidating unchanged declarations. Copying branch-gate's shallow checkout without supplying the comparison base can cause configuration failures. Leaving docs-impact in the failover lane preserves an expensive rerun path.
Disposition: specify relocation to opened/synchronize/reopened/edited coverage outside BOTH merge lanes, with the intended base available and unchanged fail-closed declaration-versus-diff semantics. Test open-invalid, body-fix and synchronize-invalidates-body cases. Keep CI triggers and required-check names unchanged.

2. **sharpens-framing — remove the CI duplicate without silently deleting local coverage.**
Evidence: the dependency is in shared check:framework-source, not a check:merge-only dependency list; the verify task explicitly supports local merge-base mode.
Failure mode: deleting that line also removes an existing local check path for ordinary product work, while the new activation/widen pre-push path covers only two PR classes. A body-file-only call also omits commit-message inspection unless those inputs are supplied.
Disposition: state which invocation is redundant and preserve local closing-keyword/commit-range validation outside that CI invocation. Verify that the live CI duplicate is absent while local validation still catches invalid commit messages. This sharpens B's scope without requiring a new gate or branch-protection change.

3. **sharpens-framing — offline admission should reuse identity checks, not become a token-presence green light.**
Evidence: Path B already verifies changed nonterminal briefs' issue references, rejects unmatched marks and malformed/set productPullRequest metadata, and distinguishes removals. General admission separately handles leftovers and skip-active delivery.
Failure mode: a batch activation with a missing or wrong story mark passes a simple “contains deft-story: N” check but still needs a post-open fix. Blanket enforcement on lifecycle diffs instead breaks the preserved leftover exemption.
Disposition: cover checks possible without a PR number: canonical parsing, diff classification and changed-brief identity coverage. Leave PR-number-bound product stamp checks to live admission. Test missing/wrong/partial batch marks, malformed metadata, valid activation/widen and leftover exemption. Body text remains data: deft-story cannot grant closing consent or substitute for landed file_scope.

4. **sharpens-framing — specify the ordering boundary and limits of prevention.**
Evidence: core-phase-5-6 distinguishes worktree completion, opening a finalize PR, durable landing and updating the merger's base. The draft correctly leaves cross-story mid-flight widen races residual. Its narrow checks plus advisory path comparison do not establish complete story-schema validation or catch CHANGELOG wording quality.
Failure mode: the next activation is built on a stale base even after the leftover PR merges, causing another strict-base rerun. Alternatively, batching is read as permission to include unapproved stories or dispatch against unlanded scope. Overstating A's coverage makes recurring semantic fix pushes appear to violate its promise.
Disposition: specify merged leftover land -> fetch/refresh activation base -> prepare the approved cohort activation batch -> land -> dispatch against landed authority. Keep batching subordinate to cohort consent and story gates. Describe A as catching the specified deterministic misses; advisory file_scope findings remain warnings, never write authorization or a guarantee against all review-fix heads.

Injection/swarm lens: preserve read-only pull_request execution and REST/env/argument handling for untrusted PR text. Do not interpolate body text into shell code or switch to privileged pull_request_target execution of candidate code. Reuse declaration parsing and closing-intent authority separation. C needs no new global lifecycle lock and grants no authority over sibling worktrees.

Road not taken: retaining body checks in the merge lane minimizes workflow drift but preserves full-job reruns for metadata repair. I prefer relocation with the event/input coverage above; inability to preserve declaration-versus-diff validation without changing required-check contracts would flip that choice. A full pre-pr mandate would catch more schema/semantic misses, but contradicts this narrow latency intervention and is not justified by this pin-read review.

Critic complete; returning to parent synthesis. No ingest.

## Inventory (existing mechanisms before new ones)

- content/commands.md near verify:completed-tracked: lifecycle-only / file-copy lands refuse the drive-to pre-pr+review-cycle+suite envelope. Prefer-A correctly keeps leftover-complete on that exemption.
- .github/workflows/branch-gate.yml: closing-keywords job on types [opened, synchronize, reopened, edited].
- .github/workflows/ci.yml: bare pull_request: (GitHub default types exclude edited). docs-impact steps live inside merge-gate-primary (~L191-197) and merge-gate-failover (~L487-493) after task check:merge. Required aggregator surface stays TypeScript yes; merge-gate aggregator not branch-protection required.
- Taskfile.yml L455: check:framework-source / check:merge deps still include verify:closing-keywords (duplicate of branch-gate path).
- packages/core/src/pr-closing-keywords/main.ts: evaluateFullStoryMarkAdmission only invoked when args.pr !== null (~L1045); inside the function, changedNonterminal.length === 0 || args.prNumber === null returns ok:true (~L477). Offline --body-file never hard-fails missing deft-story.
- content/skills/deft-directive-review-cycle/SKILL.md: empty-commit / empty-commit-thrash forbids exist; gh run rerun --failed is not named for body-only docs-impact recovery.
- content/skills/deft-directive-swarm/references/core-phase-5-6.md: strong leftover-complete / finalize-cohort / cascade-rebase prose; the issue/Prefer-A cites at :215 and :272 are Phase 6 post-merge cascade/finalize text, not leftover-before-next-activation or batch-activations order.

Prefer-A A+B+C inventory is mostly accurate. Findings below change how limbs must be stated before bind.

## Finding 1 — Limb C mis-cites core-phase-5-6 as existing activation-order pointers

classification: sharpens-framing

evidence: Issue body and Prefer-A draft claim existing guidance already points to leftover-complete-before-next-activation and batch activations via core-phase-5-6.md:215 and :272. Pin-read of those regions at e463c92d shows Greptile-errored / cascade-rebase / complete-cohort / finalize-cohort post-merge closeout, not pre-spawn lifecycle PR order.

failure mode: Binding C as cite-and-tighten of those lines lets implementers invent order from cascade prose, or land a no-op doc edit that claims the pointer already existed.

disposition consequence: Prefer-A Bound must state C as new MUST/SHOULD guidance with concrete order text (leftover-complete land before opening the next activation; batch activations per cohort; mid-story widen vs other-story activation remains named residual). Drop or replace the :215/:272 cite-and-tighten claim.

## Finding 2 — Limb B edited-triggered wording vs branch-gate-shaped types; P2 causal path

classification: sharpens-framing

evidence: Tip ci.yml on.pull_request has no types: list, so defaults omit edited. docs-impact therefore does not re-run on pure body edits today; it runs only when merge-gate-primary/failover runs (opened/synchronize/reopened, or a manual/job rerun). branch-gate.yml already lists edited among its types. Prefer-A draft says move docs-impact into an edited-triggered job the way branch-gate handles closing-keywords.

failure mode: Reading edited-triggered as edited-only drops docs-impact from first-open/synchronize CI until someone edits the body. Separately, Stop 1 P2 overstates a direct body-edit to merge-gate link that tip ci.yml does not implement; measured re-runs after body fixes more likely came from synchronize/empty-commit or gh run rerun of the failed merge-gate job.

disposition consequence: Prefer-A B must name a branch-gate-shaped job types list including opened, synchronize, reopened, and edited (not edited-only), remove docs-impact steps from merge-gate-primary/failover, and keep required TypeScript/Greptile surface unchanged. Interim review-cycle naming of gh run rerun <id> --failed remains correct and additive (confirmed absent on tip SKILL).

## Finding 3 — Dropping closing-keywords from check:merge needs remaining agent-visible enforcement

classification: sharpens-framing

evidence: verify:closing-keywords is in Taskfile.yml check:framework-source deps at L455 and therefore inside non-required merge-gate. branch-gate.yml still runs closing-keywords, also outside the issue-stated required TypeScript + Greptile surface. Issue notes agents wait on merge-gate before merging; that informal wait is what makes the merge-gate duplicate agent-visible today.

failure mode: Binding remove duplicate from check:merge as written, without naming the remaining wait surface, lets merge-path owners treat merge-gate green as enough while closing-keywords failed only on branch-gate.

disposition consequence: Prefer-A B must state remaining enforcement after the drop: branch-gate closing-keywords stays the CI signal agents honor for that check, plus limb A offline pr:check-closing-keywords --body-file on activation/widen before first push. Do not imply check:merge green still covers closing-keywords.

## Finding 4 — Advisory file_scope-coverage oracle underspecified

classification: sharpens-framing

evidence: Prefer-A adds warn-only coverage that file_scope covers the files the brief plan names, with Reject/Keep-outs forbidding writes and paths from issue text (#3835 / #4956). Tip has no such advisory checker yet; plan names is not a closed field set.

failure mode: Implementers invent path extraction from issue/comment prose or from unbounded narrative text, colliding with #3835, or warn on noise that agents treat as soft authority to widen file_scope.

disposition consequence: Bound limb must name the in-brief oracle (durable brief fields already on the activation/widen artifact only) and keep warn-only / never-write / never-lift-from-issue-text as hard keep-outs.

## Finding 5 — Offline deft-story gap confirmed (supports limb A)

classification: footnote

evidence: main.ts ~L1045 admission gated on args.pr !== null; ~L477 null prNumber short-circuits to ok:true. Matches Prefer-A / Stop 1 P1 claim. No disposition change beyond keeping the offline deft-story hard-fail in limb A.

## Finding 6 — Leftover exemption and empty-commit forbid confirmed

classification: footnote

evidence: commands.md file-copy / lifecycle-only exemption and review-cycle empty-commit forbids match Prefer-A keep-outs and interim B guidance. No reopen.

## Injection / swarm lens

Target changes shared CI merge-gate composition, workflow triggers, and through-merge / swarm lifecycle envelopes. Lens applies.

- Authority: moving docs-impact and dropping check:merge closing-keywords changes which non-required jobs encode body/keyword policy. Bound must keep branch-protection required checks unchanged (already in Reject) and name agent-visible substitutes (Findings 2–3).
- Concurrency / shared state: Limb C ordering leftover-complete before next activation serializes cohort lifecycle heads under strict=true. Guidance-only without a gate still races mid-story widen vs other-story activation (Prefer-A already names that residual). Do not silently promote C into a hard pre-dispatch deny without a separate limb.
- Envelopes: Limb A narrow pre-push on activation/widen must name the PR-class classifier (activation / thin widen / leftover-shaped) so swarm leaves do not apply or skip the wrong set. Reuse existing brief-land / leftover shape helpers rather than a new NLP class.

## Road not taken

Rejected as co-equal v1 latency fix: widen #3678 artifact-only allowlist to xbrief/active/**. That would skip merge-gate for activation lands and also skip write-fence-adjacent checks; Prefer-A Reject correctly keeps it out. Would flip only with a separate design that proves active-brief lands cannot weaken #4956 fence authority.

## Steelman

Strongest rejected lean: keep docs-impact inside merge-gate and ship only gh run rerun --failed + limb A offline checks (no workflow move, no check:merge drop). That avoids Findings 2–3 placement risk and still cuts empty-commit thrash. Flip Prefer-A B toward that narrower cut if a branch-gate-shaped docs-impact job cannot preserve first-open/synchronize coverage without touching required-check names, or if dropping closing-keywords from check:merge cannot name a remaining agent-visible signal.

## Census
